subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add WhatsApp unauthorized-group auto-leave and group-add notification as an opt-in bundled WhatsApp plugin feature now, and what trigger/authorization contract should it use?
rationale: The source proves the requested behavior is missing, but auto-leave and manual leave change a security boundary, add new config/event surfaces, and can remove the bot from groups destructively.

options.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
options.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, owner notification, and live-proof requirements before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Defer To Shared Group Pairing
options.body: Keep this linked to the broader group-pairing design and avoid a WhatsApp-specific hook until shared owner-notification semantics are settled.

options.title: Keep Allowlist-Only Posture
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw should continue dropping unauthorized WhatsApp group traffic and document manual cleanup instead of adding auto-leave behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
recommendation.body: Define group admission, join-event, leave authorization, owner notification, and live-proof requirements before implementation proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent review and adjacent WhatsApp config/runtime history among the routing candidates.
